payload.reason: The evidence indicates that pairwise ranking models outperform classification models in cross-corpus and cross-lingual evaluations, which is why classification-based models were not used for the zero-shot experiments.

claims.text: Pairwise ranking models perform better than classification models for zero-shot, cross-lingual evaluation scenarios.
The proposed model, N P RM, achieved high ranking accuracy, indicating its effectiveness over classification approaches.
Classification metrics showed lower performance compared to ranking metrics in the context of the experiments.
